approach: Add one integration test, crates/athena-core/tests/buy_first.rs. It reads the workspace Cargo.toml with toml_edit (already an athena-core dependency, so no Cargo.toml change) and takes every `[workspace.dependencies]` entry with no `path` key as an external crate. It reads docs/decisions.md, keeps only the entries headed "Buy before build" (D36 and a new D173), and requires each external crate to appear there as an exact backticked name. The decision log is append-only, so D36 cannot be edited. D173 is appended to record the call for proc-macro2, syn and toml_edit, which D36 lacks, and names the need each meets. A negative test appends a stray crate to a copy of Cargo.toml and shows it refused. A second negative test runs the check against D36 alone and shows the three known gaps found. A spec test follows the model_roster.rs pattern for OLY-B-STD-03. Then fill the spec entry, add one line to xtask/shard-timings.txt (a ci_shards test requires it), and add a CHANGELOG line. Cargo.toml is not touched.

decisions.choice: Put the crate calls for proc-macro2, syn and toml_edit in a new appended decision D173, and have the test accept crates named in any decision headed 'Buy before build' (D36 and D173).
decisions.reason: docs/decisions.md is append-only: mirrors.rs (around line 241) refuses any change to a base line, and every new entry needs a `## D<n> · ` heading and a Provenance bullet (mirrors.rs line 23). D36 (lines 806-835) names every other external crate but not these three. D172 (line 4968) is the last entry, so D173 is next.

rejected.option: Edit the D36 bullet list in place
rejected.why: Refused by the append-only rule in mirrors.rs and by D122's test.

rejected.option: Hold the call in a new table or file outside the decision log
rejected.why: The brief points at D36, and a second record would drift from it.

decisions.choice: Match a crate only as an exact backticked name, e.g. `toml_edit`, in the buy-before-build entries.
decisions.reason: D36 writes every crate as a backticked name. Plain substring search would accept `toml_edit` because `toml` is named, so the check would never fail for it.

rejected.why: False pass for toml_edit via toml, and syn via other words.

decisions.choice: Parse Cargo.toml with toml_edit, already a dependency of athena-core (crates/athena-core/Cargo.toml line 26), and treat an entry as external when it has no `path` key.
decisions.reason: Buy-first: no new crate and no hand-written line scan. Integration tests can use the package's normal dependencies, so athena-core/Cargo.toml stays unchanged.

rejected.why: Breaks on inline tables with features and on reordering.

rejected.option: Add the toml crate to athena-core dev-dependencies
rejected.why: Adds a dependency edge, and toml_edit already does the job.

decisions.choice: Do not create xtask/tests/buy_first.rs, and leave crates/athena-core/Cargo.toml unchanged, though both are listed as deliverables.
decisions.reason: A second copy of the test in xtask would duplicate the athena-core test and would need its own shard-timings line. athena-core already reads toml_edit, so no manifest change is needed. The measure and spec test name the athena-core test only.

rejected.why: Two tests that assert the same fact can drift apart.

decisions.choice: Run the check as a pure function over two texts, `unrecorded(cargo_toml, decisions)`, with the spec check likewise a function over the spec text.
decisions.reason: A mutated copy of the real text can then be passed in for the negative cases. This follows model_roster.rs, where a mutated athena.toml is refused. The real-file test and the negatives run the same function.

rejected.why: It would put the logic in the double. The real Cargo.toml and decisions.md texts are used.

decisions.choice: The measure ends with `status: not shown` and names the test command.
decisions.reason: No `athena status` line prints dependency calls. OLY-B-STD-04 and OLY-B-STD-05 (spec.toml lines 2375 and 2387) do the same.

rejected.option: Add a new STATUS_MEASURE_LABELS entry and status line
rejected.why: Larger than the request, and the brief puts it out of scope.

files.purpose: The mechanism: `repo_file`, `external_crates`, `buy_first_record`, `unrecorded` and `spec_entry_problems`, with the real-file test, the stray-crate and D36-alone negatives, and the spec test with mutated-copy negatives.

OLY-B-STD-03: replace `mechanism = "none"` with the buy-first check (the test file and the D36/D173 decision log), keep owner Athena, and replace the measure with one that names `cargo test -p athena-core --test buy_first` and ends `status: not shown`.
Append D173 at the end, headed 'Buy before build', recording the calls for proc-macro2, syn and toml_edit with the unmet needs, the options turned down, and a Provenance bullet. D36 is not edited.
One line under Unreleased > Added: OLY-B-STD-03 now has a mechanism, with the test name and the `status: not shown` measure.
Add `athena-core --test buy_first 5.00` after `athena-core --lib 15.00`. Required by ci_shards.rs line 411. This file is not in the brief's deliverables list but is not a governance file.

steps: Read crates/athena-core/tests/model_roster.rs lines 11-16 and 50-68 again. Create crates/athena-core/tests/buy_first.rs with a module comment naming OLY-B-STD-03 and D36/D173, a copy of `repo_file`, and `external_crates(cargo_toml: &str) -> Vec<String>`, which parses with toml_edit::DocumentMut and returns the `[workspace.dependencies]` keys whose value has no `path` key.

In the same file add `buy_first_record(decisions: &str) -> String`, which splits the log at lines starting `## D` and concatenates the sections whose heading contains 'Buy before build'. Add `unrecorded(cargo_toml, decisions) -> Vec<String>`, which returns the external crates with no exact backticked `name` in that record. Add `spec_entry_problems(spec: &str) -> Vec<String>`, which finds the `id = "OLY-B-STD-03"` entry and returns a problem for each of: mechanism `none`, mechanism missing `buy_first` or `D36`, owner not Athena, measure not ending `status: not shown`, measure not naming the test command.

Add the tests: every_external_workspace_crate_is_recorded_in_the_buy_first_decisions; a_stray_dependency_is_refused; d36_alone_leaves_the_three_known_gaps (also checks `toml` is recorded while `toml_edit` is not); path_crates_are_not_external; spec_entry_has_a_real_mechanism; spec_check_refuses_a_none_mechanism, a wrong owner and a measure ending `status: requirement`. Add no new crate import.

Append `## D173 · Buy before build: syn, proc-macro2 and toml_edit are adopted, and a test ties the dependency list to the record` to docs/decisions.md after D172, in the D172 format. Name the unmet need for each: syn and proc-macro2 for function-length and design-surface scans, where brace counting breaks on strings and macros (the D132 note at line 3356); toml_edit for rewriting configuration and proposals while keeping comments and layout, which the toml crate does not. State that D36 is unchanged, why (append-only), and that the test reads D36 and D173 together. Add a Provenance bullet listing what was read and measured.

Edit docs/spec.toml lines 2361 and 2363: set mechanism to the buy-first check (`crates/athena-core/tests/buy_first.rs` checks every external [workspace.dependencies] crate is named in the Buy-before-build decisions D36 and D173 in docs/decisions.md and refuses a stray one; whether a maintained option exists stays the verifier's judgement). Keep `owner = "Athena"`. Set measure to `cargo test -p athena-core --test buy_first; status: not shown`, with a short clause before the final label. Leave statement, kind and sources as they are.
Add `athena-core --test buy_first 5.00` to xtask/shard-timings.txt after `athena-core --lib 15.00` (keep it sorted).
Add one line under Unreleased > Added in CHANGELOG.md in the style of the OLY-B-RUN-02 line: mechanism, test name, D173, measure `status: not shown`, and that Cargo.toml is unchanged.

Run `cargo fmt --all --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings`, `cargo test --locked`, `cargo test -p xtask --test spec`, `cargo test -p xtask --test ci_shards` and `cargo test -p xtask --test policy`.

risks.risk: A crate is listed in D173 or D36 but not actually the one in Cargo.toml, e.g. a renamed package key.
risks.mitigation: The check keys on the `[workspace.dependencies]` entry name, and all current entries use their own crate name. A rename would be seen as a new unrecorded name and refused.

risks.risk: The check can only show that a call was recorded. It cannot judge whether a maintained option exists.
risks.mitigation: The measure states this, the brief puts it out of scope, and the verifier keeps that judgement. Status stays `not shown`.

risks.risk: Appending to docs/decisions.md trips the mirror structure checks (heading form, Provenance bullet, trailing newline).
risks.mitigation: D173 copies the D172 shape (Case, Decision, Alternatives, Tradeoff, Reversal cost, Provenance), ends with a single newline, and uses the `## D173 · ` heading. The mirror tests run in `cargo test`.

risks.risk: The shard-timings line is forgotten and ci_shards fails.
risks.mitigation: A plan step adds it and the criterion 5 demonstration runs `cargo test -p xtask --test ci_shards`.

risks.risk: A future dependency with a `git` or `registry` key and no `path` key is treated as external. A future path-only crate is exempt.
risks.mitigation: That is the intended rule: only in-repository path crates are exempt. The negative test uses a plain version entry.

demonstrations.method: Run the spec test. It reads the real docs/spec.toml, takes the OLY-B-STD-03 entry and checks four things: no `mechanism = "none"`; the mechanism text contains `buy_first` and `D36`; `owner = "Athena"`; the measure ends `status: not shown` and contains `cargo test -p athena-core --test buy_first`. The verifier can also run `cargo test -p xtask --test spec` and open docs/spec.toml.
demonstrations.observes: The entry no longer says none, names the test file and the D36 decision log, keeps owner Athena, and its measure ends with `status: not shown`. The spec test passes.
demonstrations.fails_without: With the old entry (`mechanism = "none"`, measure `The spec gap list; status: requirement`) the assertions fail.
demonstrations.seam: Production entry point: the docs/spec.toml text, read by repo_file in the new test file (the helper copied from model_roster.rs lines 11-16). Fixture: the real file. The pure function `spec_entry_problems(spec: &str) -> Vec<String>` is added in the plan step that writes the test; it is a new function.

demonstrations.method: Run the whole test file. `every_external_workspace_crate_is_recorded_in_the_buy_first_decisions` reads the real Cargo.toml and docs/decisions.md and calls `unrecorded`, which lists external `[workspace.dependencies]` crates (entries without `path`) not named as backticked exact names in the entries headed 'Buy before build'. It asserts the list is empty. `a_stray_dependency_is_refused` appends `left-pad-rs = "1"` under `[workspace.dependencies]` in a copy of Cargo.toml and asserts `unrecorded` returns exactly that crate. `d36_alone_leaves_the_three_known_gaps` passes only the D36 section and asserts the result is proc-macro2, syn and toml_edit. That test shows the check fails without D173 and rejects the `toml` substring false pass.
demonstrations.observes: The real-file test passes and both negative tests pass: the stray crate is refused, and D36 alone is refused for the three unrecorded crates.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the check, `unrecorded` does not exist and the file does not compile. Without D173, the real-file test fails naming proc-macro2, syn and toml_edit. With the check weakened to substring matching, the D36-only test fails because toml_edit would be accepted.
demonstrations.seam: Production entry point: `unrecorded(cargo_toml, decisions)`, a new function in crates/athena-core/tests/buy_first.rs added in the step that creates the file. Its parse is toml_edit::DocumentMut, which exists today as an athena-core dependency (Cargo.toml line 26). Fixture: the real Cargo.toml and docs/decisions.md texts read through repo_file, with in-memory mutated copies for the negatives. Nothing is injected, and the logic under test is the function itself, not the fixture.

demonstrations.method: `spec_entry_has_a_real_mechanism` runs `spec_entry_problems` on the real spec and asserts it is empty. `spec_check_refuses_a_none_mechanism` takes a copy of the spec, restores `mechanism = "none"` on the OLY-B-STD-03 entry, and asserts a problem is reported. The same function is run on copies with owner changed away from Athena and with the measure ending `status: requirement`, and each reports a problem.
demonstrations.observes: The real entry passes. The three mutated copies are each refused: mechanism none, owner not Athena, and a measure not ending `status: not shown`.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the mechanism text, the real entry is flagged. Without the check, a `none` mechanism passes silently.
demonstrations.seam: Production entry point: `spec_entry_problems(spec: &str)`, new, in crates/athena-core/tests/buy_first.rs. It follows spec_entry_has_a_real_mechanism (model_roster.rs lines 50-68), which exists today. Fixture: the real docs/spec.toml with string-replaced copies, built in the test.

demonstrations.method: Run the real-file test. The verifier can also run `git diff --stat` and `git diff Cargo.toml` to see that Cargo.toml is unchanged and docs/decisions.md only grows at the end. D173 names proc-macro2 and syn (function length in code_health.rs, design-surface scans in design_surface.rs, and the existing D132 note at decisions.md line 3356), and toml_edit (edits that keep comments and layout in toolconfig.rs and proposals.rs, and reads in iris.rs, admission.rs and mirrors.rs). For each it names the unmet need and the option turned down: brace counting or a lint tool for syn, and the toml crate for toml_edit, which cannot rewrite a file without losing its comments.
demonstrations.observes: The real-file test passes, `git diff` shows no change to Cargo.toml, the mirror check for the decision log (append-only plus Provenance bullet) passes, and D173 sits after D172 with a Provenance bullet.
demonstrations.fails_without: If D173 is missing or omits a crate, `every_external_workspace_crate_is_recorded_in_the_buy_first_decisions` fails naming it.
demonstrations.seam: Production entry point: `unrecorded` as above. The append-only rule is mirrors.rs and is checked by the existing mirror tests, which run in `cargo test`. Both exist today.

demonstrations.method: Run the three Athena checks at the workspace root, then `cargo test -p xtask --test spec` and `cargo test -p xtask --test ci_shards`. The new test file uses only std, athena-core's existing dependencies and its own helpers. The ci_shards test `checked_in_timings_cover_every_workspace_test_unit` (ci_shards.rs line 411) compares xtask/shard-timings.txt with the workspace test units, so the plan adds the line `athena-core --test buy_first 5.00` after `athena-core --lib 15.00`.
demonstrations.command: cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings && cargo test --locked
demonstrations.observes: All three checks and the two xtask tests pass.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the timings line, checked_in_timings_cover_every_workspace_test_unit fails. Without the spec edit, buy_first fails.
demonstrations.seam: The existing check commands and the existing xtask tests, which exist today. The shard-timings line is added in the plan step for that file.

demonstrations.method: Read the diff. It touches only the test file, docs/spec.toml, docs/decisions.md, CHANGELOG.md and xtask/shard-timings.txt. No file under crates/athena-core/src, athena-data/src or the job pipeline changes. The plan adds no parser, stem list or reading check, so the refusal corpus (crates/athena-core/tests/refusal_corpus.rs) has no case to add.
demonstrations.observes: No change under crates/*/src. The test is not run by the pipeline against readings, so no reading is newly refused.
